_description: Content-based floor signals for the audit find pipeline (audit/workflows/find.js). A file joins a dimension's scout floor when its content matches at least one of that dimension's signals below. Single source of truth: find.js no longer contains these regexes at all, it only consumes the result via args.floorFiles, computed by audit/bin/compute-floor.mjs. These regexes replace an extension-based per-file floor for the broad dimensions (a path-based floor over most extensions matches most of a real repo, which makes the MAX_SCOUT_FILES cap in find.js inert); they instead match actual content signals derived from the ground-truth defects two real runs missed (JSON-LD critical in a provider the security scout dropped non-reproducibly, an e2e spec the code_quality scout never saw). Calibrated 2026-09-06 against a 257-file corpus, see CLAUDE.md 'The scout floor is content-based and calibrated'. Do not change, remove, or reword a single regex without re-measuring recall with a deterministic harness first: this changes WHAT the floor matches, not just where it runs. `architecture` intentionally has no entry here: it keeps the existing selective PATH-based floor only, computed in find.js's floorDimensionsForFile.

code_quality.comment: Error-swallowing, sentinel fallbacks, bypassed checks and weak/conditional assertions.

ui_design.comment: Token declarations and spacing/shape utilities, not every CSS variable reference.

typography.comment: ASCII quotes alone mostly match programming-language string delimiters.

ux.comment: Busy/disabled/live feedback and state changes with no visible error handler.

docs_sync.comment: Documented API references and public configuration are documentation drift surfaces.

copy.comment: Rendered/returned translations and explicit microcopy labels, not every schema label.

payments.comment: Stripe SDK usage, webhook verification, hosted/checkout surfaces and payment identifiers.
